asked.item: Why TikTok videos always get about 30 views

verdict.reason: The TikTok FAQ says what consistently under 50 views means and what it recommends.

steps.text: If your views are consistently under 50, something is wrong with your account.
If you have 10 videos in a row that all get under 50 views, your account is likely shadowbanned.
The help page recommends starting fresh with a new account.
